declarations.rationale: Champion, retained-title and held-crown constructions dominate the full dictionary.
President title paths form the largest specific office family; director and economist are distinct competing roles.
Team-to-person coach constructions dominate, with explicit coach appositives and inverse coached-team syntax.
Urge direct-object is the highest-frequency path and largest coherent family; presidency is a competing minority.
Be-at, visit, pass-through and venue-at constructions form the largest coherent location-presence family. Manager/succession rows compete.
Meeting-with and meet-with dominate the dictionary; merely anticipated summits require modal review.
Borough-to-president inverse constructions dominate the specific directional family. Person-to-institution director/president rows have reverse roles.
Five distinct review-performance/program paths form the largest coherent specific action family, alongside sports-venue and territorial-control paths.
Leave direct-object paths dominate; institutional versus physical departure is checked per case.
Inverse leader/majority-leader family totals six rows and includes the highest repeated path; ownership is the competing five-row family.
Live-in, resident-of, population residence and ghetto residence form the largest residence family; officials and chairmen are competing office signals.
Analyst-with and follow/track-for paths dominate the full dictionary.
Inverse leader, president, government-head paths dominate; political adjectives may truncate the institution.
Area/neighborhood/section of borough paths dominate.
Passive controlled-by and wrest-control-from political-body paths dominate, distinct from ordinary membership or inverse head titles.
Live-in is the dominant repeated interpretable family, with migration/entry/work as competing weaker location evidence.
Meeting/conference/speech/funeral/hotel physical-location paths form the largest coherent family; inverse lawyer rows and aliases compete.
Corporate unit/part-of paths overwhelmingly dominate.
Inverse possessed-lawyer/attorney and hired-lawyer constructions dominate.
Venue-to-street at constructions dominate, with event scheduling fragments reviewed for location attachment.
Testimony-before/to, address, advise and comments-to establish a dominant directed communication family; lawyer titles compete.
Corporate part/unit-of constructions form the largest family; branch-office locations and candidate-office paths compete.
Possessed-minister and minister appositives form the largest specific interpretable family; say-in is higher frequency but reporting-place syntax alone does not express a stable office predicate.
Died-at-home-in is the highest-frequency path and dominant family; live-in and professional roles remain distinct.
